<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern, the most distinctive feature is a strong M+2 peak (m/z 185) with an intensity about one‑third that of the monoisotopic peak (m/z 183). This 1 : 3 ratio is characteristic of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 75 % : 25 %). No other element shows a comparable definitive pattern (e.g., bromine would give a ~1 : 1 M+2, sulfur a much smaller M+2, etc.). Therefore chlorine is the only element that can be identified with certainty.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
